document.abstract: In order to set the analysis that follows in perspective, let us divide the field of video cassettes, etc., into three classes: the prerecorded sort of thing that emulates today's phonograph and audio cassette business, the “do-it-yourself” kind of business that is typified by the Port-a-Pac video-tape recorder and resembles the present day audio tape recorder, and finally an electronic delivery system.

authors.bio: Gordon B. Thompson is a long-range planner exploring the relationships between technology and society at Bell-Northern Research (P.O. Box 3511, Station C, Ottawa, Ont.), and is especially involved in communications theory. He joined Northern Electric in 1947 as a designer of radio and television broadcasting systems. He has been with the Laboratories since 1963.
